# Sodero Documentation

> Manuals for Sodero products. Each product has its own versioned manual; the links below point to the latest version.

## Manuals

- [Sodero Cloud](https://docs.sodero.io/sodero-cloud/latest/llms.txt): build, simulate and operate robot systems in the browser with projects, Robot Worlds and Stellar Station in the cloud.
- [Stellar X](https://docs.sodero.io/stellar-x/latest/llms.txt): the Stellar X robot controller, Stellar Station, gateways, robot controllers, simulation with NVIDIA Isaac Sim and navigation.
